title: CollectedCodeData
description: Technology-agnostic raw facts collected from source code analysis. This is the intermediate representation that collectors produce and the calculation engine consumes.

collectedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when collection was performed.

collector.description: Metadata about the collector that produced this data.

tools.description: List of tools used by this collector (e.g. ['dependency-cruiser', 'jscpd', 'eslint']).

entities.description: All code entities discovered during collection.

moduleBoundaries.description: Module boundary definitions for architectural analysis.

duplicationSignals.description: Duplication detection results. Each entry comes from one tool run.

coverageSignals.description: Code coverage data. Each entry comes from one coverage format/tool.

lintSignals.description: Lint/static analysis signals. Each entry comes from one linting tool run.

provenance.description: Metadata about the collection process (timing, tool runs, warnings).
